arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: New York argues FERC Order 888 violates state authority over retail electricity sales.
FERC argues the order only regulates interstate transmission grid usage.
New York claims states regulated retail sales from 1910 until FERC acted.
FERC claims only it can effectively regulate interstate transmission grids.
